svg.text: 🩸 RaktSetu — Entity Relationship (ER) Diagram (MySQL 8.0 Relational Architecture)
Course: CS203 DBMS | SVNIT Surat · 16 Normalized Tables (3NF/BCNF) · 6 Triggers · 2 Procedures · 3 Views

g.text: KEY DBMS CONCEPTS DEMONSTRATED IN THIS SCHEMA
Primary Key (PK): Unique identifier, B-Tree indexed
Foreign Key (FK): ON UPDATE CASCADE, ON DELETE RESTRICT / CASCADE / SET NULL
Clinical Cooldown Trigger: trg_check_donation_cooldown raises SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' if <90 days
ACID Transaction Procedure: sp_interhospital_transfer with START TRANSACTION, COMMIT & ROLLBACK
Emergency Matching Procedure: sp_match_emergency_donors ranks EXACT vs COMPATIBLE ABO/Rh groups
3NF / BCNF Normalization: Zero transitive dependencies, city coordinates and blood groups isolated
